arxiv-1807-07964.title: Question-Aware Sentence Gating Networks for Question and Answering
arxiv-1807-07964.creator: Minjeong Kim, David Keetae Park, Hyungjong Noh, Yeonsoo Lee, Jaegul Choo
arxiv-1807-07964.description: Abstract Machine comprehension question answering, which finds an answer to the question given a passage, involves high-level reasoning processes of understanding and tracking the relevant contents across various semantic units such as words, phrases, and sentences in a document. This paper proposes the novel question-aware sentence gating networks that directly incorporate the sentence-level information into word-level encoding processes.

arxiv-2103-00554.title: Effects of thermal emission on Chandrasekhar’s semi-infinite diffuse reflection problem Journal: APJ
arxiv-2103-00554.creator: Soumya Sengupta
arxiv-2103-00554.description: Abstract I Abstract Context : The analytical results of Chandrasekhar’s semi-infinite diffuse reflection problem is crucial in the context of stellar or planetary atmosphere. However, the atmospheric emission effect was not taken into account in this model, and the solutions are applicable only for diffusely scattering atmosphere in absence of emission.

arxiv-2312-06369.title: Entanglement and volume monogamy features of permutation symmetric N N -qubit pure states with N N -distinct spinors: GHZ and W W ¯ \bar{\rm W} states
arxiv-2312-06369.creator: Sudha, A. R. Usha Devi, H. Akshata Shenoy, H. S. Karthik, Talath Humera, B. P. Govindaraja, A. K. Rajagopal
arxiv-2312-06369.description: Abstract We explore the entanglement features of pure symmetric N N -qubit states characterized by N N -distinct spinors with a particular focus on the Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger(GHZ) states and W W ¯ \bar{\rm W} , an equal superposition of W and obverse W states.

arxiv-2403-03572.creator: Johann S. Brauchart, Peter J. Grabner ‡
arxiv-2403-03572.description: Abstract . We extend the notion of hyperuniformity to the projective spaces ℝ ​ ℙ d − 1 \mathbb{RP}^{d-1} , ℂ ​ ℙ d − 1 \mathbb{CP}^{d-1} , ℍ ​ ℙ d − 1 \mathbb{HP}^{d-1} , and 𝕆 ​ ℙ 2 \mathbb{OP}^{2} .

arxiv-2412-12950.title: Nonlocal Choquard equations involving critical Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev exponent: the effect of the topology of the domain
arxiv-2412-12950.description: Abstract We apply a topological method to prove existence of positive solutions for the nonlineair Choquard equation with upper critical exponent in the sense of Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev inquality on bounded domains having nontrivial homology group. Keywords: Choquard equation, Critical nonlinearity, Variational calculus, Singular Homology, Topological method. MSC 2020.

arxiv-2508-20591.title: Bitcoin as an Interplanetary Monetary Standard with Proof-of-Transit Timestamping
arxiv-2508-20591.creator: Jose E. Puente Mobiletalk-Q, SL jepuente@talk-q.com and Carlos Puente Mobiletalk-Q, SL carlospuenteg@talk-q.com
arxiv-2508-20591.description: Abstract We explore the feasibility of deploying Bitcoin as the shared monetary standard between Earth and Mars, accounting for physical constraints of interplanetary communication. We introduce a novel primitive, Proof-of-Transit Timestamping (PoTT), to provide cryptographic, tamper-evident audit trails for Bitcoin data across high-latency, intermittently-connected links.

arxiv-2509-01876.title: Far-infrared probing with PRIMA into particle acceleration associated with relativistic jets from active galactic nuclei
arxiv-2509-01876.creator: Naoki Isobe, Takao Nakagawa, Motoki Kino, Hiroshi Nagai, Shunsuke Baba, Makoto Tashiro
arxiv-2509-01876.description: Abstract It is presented that the Probe far-Infrared Mission for Astrophysics (PRIMA) has a high potential to study particle acceleration phenomena associated with jets emanating from active galactic nuclei. A special focus is put on hot spots of radio galaxies because they are widely regarded as the jet-terminal shock where particles are accelerated via the diffusive shock acceleration.

arxiv-2509-18632.title: A Good Plan is Hard to Find: * Aligning Models with Preferences is Misaligned with What Helps Users
arxiv-2509-18632.creator: Nishant Balepur Matthew Shu Yoo Yeon Sung Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant, Shi Feng Fumeng Yang Rachel Rudinger Jordan Boyd-Graber
arxiv-2509-18632.description: Abstract To assist users in complex tasks, llm s generate plans: step-by-step instructions towards a goal. While alignment methods aim to ensure llm plans are helpful, they train ( rlhf ) or evaluate (ChatbotArena) on what users prefer, assuming this reflects what helps them.

arxiv-2602-12032.title: When would Vision-Proprioception Policies Fail in Robotic Manipulation?
arxiv-2602-12032.creator: Jingxian Lu, Wenke Xia, Yuxuan Wu, Zhiwu Lu, Di Hu
arxiv-2602-12032.description: Abstract Proprioceptive information is critical for precise servo control by providing real-time robotic states. Its collaboration with vision is highly expected to enhance performances of the manipulation policy in complex tasks. However, recent studies have reported inconsistent observations on the generalization of vision-proprioception policies. In this work, we investigate this by conducting temporally controlled experiments.

pmc-11434529.title: An FPGA-Based YOLOv5 Accelerator for Real-Time Industrial Vision Applications
pmc-11434529.creator: Zhihong Yan, Bingqian Zhang, Dong Wang, Piero Malcovati, José de Jesús Rangel Magdaleno
pmc-11434529.description: The You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detection network has garnered widespread adoption in various industries, owing to its superior inference speed and robust detection capabilities. This model has proven invaluable in automating production processes such as material processing, machining, and quality inspection. However, as market competition intensifies, there is a constant demand for higher detection speed and accuracy.

pmc-11675340.title: Influence of Seed Disinfection Treatments on the Germination Rate and Histamine-Degrading Activity of Legume Sprouts
pmc-11675340.creator: Judit Costa-Catala, Jaume Bori, M. Teresa Veciana-Nogués, M. Luz Latorre-Moratalla, M. Carmen Vidal-Carou, Oriol Comas-Basté
pmc-11675340.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Edible legume sprouts have been proposed as a promising plant-based source of the enzyme diamine oxidase (DAO), which plays a key role in degrading histamine at an intestinal level and preventing the development of histamine intolerance symptoms. However, the temperature and humidity conditions required for seed germination can also favor the rapid growth of yeast and mold, potentially compromising sprout yield and quality.

pmc-13414873.title: Independent and sex-stratified association between microsatellite instability and peripheral hemoglobin in colorectal cancer
pmc-13414873.creator: Yang Lu, Hao Wang, Gang Chen
pmc-13414873.description: BackgroundMicrosatellite instability (MSI) informs colorectal cancer (CRC) prognosis and treatment. Although anemia is common in CRC, whether peripheral hemoglobin (HB) differs according to MSI status independently of sex, tumor location, stage, and selected nutritional covariates remains unclear. This exploratory study evaluated the association between MSI status and HB and described sex-stratified discrimination within the study cohort.

pmc-13598654.title: How to Perform a Tracer Displacement BRET Assay for the TRPML1 Ion Channel
pmc-13598654.creator: Micael R. Cunha, Carolina M. C. Catta-Preta, Katlin B. Massirer, Rafael M. Couñago
pmc-13598654.description: The transient receptor mucolipin subtype 1 (TRPML1) is a ubiquitously expressed ion channel involved in lysosomal homeostasis. Recent pharmaceutical interest in developing agonist ligands has emerged due to beneficial effects in neurodegenerative diseases. The major high-throughput screening techniques to investigate this ion channel involve fluorescent calcium imaging and electrophysiology.

pmc-13619887.title: Chemical inhibition of α-mannosidase in S. mansoni schistosomula leads to reshaped N-glycosylation associated with developmental alterations
pmc-13619887.creator: Eleonore B. Kuhlemaijer, Tom Veldhuizen, Quirine C. A. Hoekstra, Jinthe A. Umbach, Mathijs J. Niezen, Josephine E. Forde-Thomas, Gabriel Rinaldi, Karl F. Hoffmann, Angela van Diepen, Cornelis H. Hokke
pmc-13619887.description: Schistosomes are parasitic flatworms that infect over 230 million people worldwide. As continuous exposure and high-reinfection rates cause severe disease in inhabitants of endemic areas, there is an urgent need for prophylactic vaccines or drugs that induce protective immunity. N-glycosylation is a conserved process in eukaryotes, including schistosomes, that affects various cellular and developmental biological processes.

pmc-13634143.title: Community-acquired Escherichia coli pneumonia: clinical, radiological, laboratory, and prognostic characteristics in a retrospective single-center study
pmc-13634143.creator: Salih Kücük, Sükran Mutlu, Coskun Dogan, Sevda Soydan
pmc-13634143.description: BACKGROUND: Community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) caused by Escherichia coli (E. coli) is uncommon, and its clinical features and prognosis remain insufficiently characterized.OBJECTIVES: To compare the clinical, laboratory, radiological, and prognostic characteristics of community-acquired E. coli pneumonia (CAECP) with CAP caused by other pathogens.
